description: Change of use of ancillary residential accommodation to offices and/or Education training facilities B1/D1(flexible use)
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (03(C), 04(D), 05(D), 06(B), 90, 91, 113(K), Location Plan and Planning Statement [received 22 November 2019]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The proposed office/education training facility comprising four rooms with ancillary kitchen and WC facilities hereby approved shall not be used for any purposes outside the B1/D1 (Office/ Education training) Use Class permitted under this application.
